http_ca_key.description: The CA private key that can be used by the new node in order to sign its certificate for the HTTP layer, as a Base64 encoded string of the ASN.1 DER encoding of the key.

http_ca_cert.description: The CA certificate that can be used by the new node in order to sign its certificate for the HTTP layer, as a Base64 encoded string of the ASN.1 DER encoding of the certificate.

transport_ca_cert.description: The CA certificate that is used to sign the TLS certificate for the transport layer, as a Base64 encoded string of the ASN.1 DER encoding of the certificate.

transport_key.description: The private key that the node can use for TLS for its transport layer, as a Base64 encoded string of the ASN.1 DER encoding of the key.

transport_cert.description: The certificate that the node can use for TLS for its transport layer, as a Base64 encoded string of the ASN.1 DER encoding of the certificate.

nodes_addresses.description: A list of transport addresses in the form of `host:port` for the nodes that are already members of the cluster.
